pure-announcement.rationale: It is a curated link digest rather than a launch, release note or funding announcement, so the announcement disqualifier does not apply even though the content is ephemeral.

duplicate.rationale: Existing MCP security concepts (authorization hardening, remote-first governance, shadow detection) overlap in topic but none already carries this digest's specific items such as overthinking-loop denial-of-wallet or the DXT privilege RCE.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every claim is a one-line summary linked to a named external source (arXiv paper, CSO article, Microsoft guide), so each is checkable.

durability.rationale: A March-2026 monthly roundup keyed to counts like '30 CVEs in 60 days' and '38% of 500 scanned servers' is a snapshot built to be superseded by the next month's digest.

actionability.rationale: Its own guidance amounts to one generic closing paragraph (restrict privileges, add timeouts and cost controls); anything a builder could act on lives in the linked resources, not in this note.

atomicity.rationale: It bundles eight unrelated resources across threat models, defenses, a CVE and CISO guidance with only a sentence on each, so there is no single core idea and no item developed enough here to stand alone.
